title: BarApp module ingredient, format version 1
description: One line of data/ingredients.jsonl: an ingredient node the module adds, always placed under an existing taxonomy node or another ingredient the module adds. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored by readers.

id.description: A dot path unique within the module; it must not collide with a taxonomy node.

parentId.description: An existing taxonomy node, or another ingredient this module adds; cycles are refused.

kind.description: A category groups; an ingredient is a leaf a bottle or a recipe line can point at.

detailFields.description: Optional detail field names for the inventory, kebab-case.
